TRAFFIC ADVISORY: A gas leak has University Boulevard West closed from Caddington Avenue to Arcola Avenue. The call was received at 12:20 p.m.

Drivers are encouraged to expect significant delays and seek an alternate route.

Single vehicle crash. Traffic Advisory: please use extra caution! A vehicle hit a power line pole on Beal Parkway in front of Lowe’s. 

All southbound traffic on Beal is being diverted down Hurlburt/MLK. 

Thankfully no major injuries were reported. https://t.co/6uN9J6Tg5I
